JSON execution-state and suspended-stack lifecycle, timestamp normalization, last-5/24-hour snapshots, last-12 references, last-8 logs/4 summaries; dynamic snapshots unbounded.

Legacy skill persistence, trader-create confirmation and resource resolution, diagnosis log excerpts, parent-task resume, target resolution; exact duplicate-name resolution picks first.
Bilingual management primers and AI/grid product-template descriptions; AI template explicitly excludes daily-loss field, which is a limited chat schema not complete futures policy.

limitations: Assigned source full/manual. Additional dependency files read only at listed ranges. No runtime, DB, account, network, or test execution. Historical graph file summaries and 20 outgoing edge samples inspected, not every historical function/edge.
